records.subject: Household Income
records.groupTitle: Average Annual Government Transfers Per Household Member Among Resident Households
records.title: Average Annual Government Transfers Per Household Member Among Resident Households by Deciles (Ranked by Household Market Income (Including Regular Government Contributions)), 2015 - 2025
records.footnote: Note: As more administrative data on transfers become available, the coverage for Government transfers has been expanded over the years to include more type of transfers. Refer to the glossary (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/files/38edc794-eaa0-4582-9c6a-3d152e18bdd1.pdf) of the latest Key Household Income Trends paper for the Government transfers that are included. Data for the latest year are preliminary. It is notable that some resident households in the lowest income decile owned a car (7.2%), employed a domestic worker (21.4%), lived in private property (8.9%) or were resident households comprising solely non-employed persons aged 65 years and over (43.0%) in 2025. Not all households are consistently in the same decile group from one year to the next. For example, a household may move from a higher to a lower decile in a particular year due to reduced income if a household member is temporarily unemployed, before moving up the deciles when the member resumes employment in the subsequent year. In comparing the performance of any particular decile group over time, it is therefore relevant to note that the comparison may not pertain to the same group of households.

column1.footnote: 1/ Based on ranking of all resident households by their monthly household market income (including regular government contributions) per household member.
